name: pkistudiomcp
postStartCommand: if [ -n "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" ] && [ -n "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" ] && [ -n "$AZURE_TENANT_ID" ] && [ -n "$AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID" ]; then az login --service-principal -u "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" -p "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" --tenant "$AZURE_TENANT_ID" >/dev/null && az account set --subscription "$AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID"; fi
